# Cursorvers.edu (cursorvers.jp)

Medical-professional AI education platform operated by Cursorvers Inc.

Primary language: Japanese.
Operator: Cursorvers Inc. (株式会社Cursorvers), Tokyo, Japan.
Author / Founder: 大田原 正幸 / Masayuki Otawara — intensive care specialist; Cursorvers Inc. Founder and Director; medical AI governance implementer.
Scope: AI literacy and clinical AI governance education for Japanese medical professionals. Phase02 paid tier: ¥2,980/month (individual subscription). This site does not recommend specific medical acts, drugs, devices, or products.
